csv_project_name: Design for the Whitecliff Park Trail Loop
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Crestwood is requesting qualifications from individuals or firms for a consultant to evaluate and assess the existing natural conditions of the Whitecliff Park trails and develop a plan to connect the existing trails to new trail or trails to create a large loop trail. Site Analysis Conduct park property line surveys where necessary. Approximately 30% of the park has been surveyed for the new community center construction. The remaining portion will need to be completed. Analyze park topography, floodplain and floodway to determine best location of the trail.
